Overview

HireNest Workforce is a technology-first workforce solutions company
delivering AI-powered recruitment, IT staffing, contract staffing,
permanent hiring, executive search, software development, and workforce
automation through the proprietary HireNest OS platform.

talent intelligence and workflow automation.

HireNest OS

HireNest OS is the company’s proprietary platform providing: - AI resume

management - Recruiter workspace - Client workspace - Analytics
dashboards - Pipeline management
